## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      5 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 24, 2026 - Aug 19, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _K T_, Aug 18, 2026, 1/5: "ever since the new update I haven't at all been able to use this app. It is constantly freezing. I put my sleep mode on my watch and it doesn't even show on the app. when I want to record something, the date is in June and I am always trying to fix it and it doesn't matter because it doesn't even hold the new info I put in there anyway. It doesn't let me reorder my home page. it doesn't let me add things I want to track on there. I uninstalled it and reinstalled and it's still frozen."
            2. _Peter Henochsberg_, Aug 18, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible App. They took an excellent, easy to use app that I have used for years and packed it so full of features hidden on impossible to find menus and made the app totally useless and unusable."
            3. _JWM B_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "Terrible update, completely ruined the app. Since the latest Samsung Health update, this app has gone downhill fast. The new UI is cluttered and confusing, and honestly feels like a step backward instead of an improvement. Worse, the app crashes constantly, which makes my Samsung Watch practically useless for sports and training. I rely on this thing for tracking workouts, and now I can't trust it to even stay open. This is three steps back, not progress. Really disappointing!"
<!--/ir-theme-->
